My only discussion topic for this week is that we can make a stub implementation for CHAINID I think <@497280885645639691> has a more correct implementation that pulls the value from the genesis file. Should we reschedule either the EIP meeting or your specs meeting? If they conflict every time that feels bad. Hi guys. I am proposing EIP-5027: Remove the limit on contract code size. excerpts.author: qizhou
excerpts.content: Hi guys.  I am proposing EIP-5027: Remove the limit on contract code size.  I understand that this is rather controversial topic in history (see https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/removing-or-increasing-the-contract-size-limit/3045) but I feel the demand is much stronger than 3 years ago, and the technical side is ready (as we have implemented one and run on our Ethereum-sidechain testnet).  Happy to receive comments and suggestions!  https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5027/files
